metadata.title: TIP: paclitaxel, ifosfamide and cisplatin
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciliation draft; independent clinical approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The currently linked v1 document has a review date of 30/04/2025; source freshness is flagged for clinical governance. This 175 mg/m² three-hour paclitaxel TIP schedule is not interchangeable with other published TIP doses/days. Mesna400 mg/m² immediately before ifosfamide and at four/eight hours AFTER its completion each day; G-CSF5 mcg/kg from day 6 until neutrophil recovery. Check neurological function and urinalysis daily with ifosfamide. Aprepitant may increase ifosfamide neurotoxicity; reconcile the entire antiemetic/steroid plan with pharmacy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Paclitaxel 175 mg/m² day 1; cisplatin20 mg/m² and ifosfamide1200 mg/m² days 1–5, with mesna; q21 days for four cycles.

administration.note: Over 3 hours with prescribed allergy premedication.
Over 2 hours; mesna400 mg/m² before and4/8 hours AFTER completion. G-CSF from day 6.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
premedication: Confirm the five-day attendance/admission plan, mesna timings, hydration, allergy prevention and growth-factor prescription.
other_support: Cisplatin needs a high-risk anti-sickness plan and prescribed hydration/electrolytes. Ifosfamide needs mesna and adequate fluids. Paclitaxel needs prescribed allergy premedication; reconcile steroid doses with antiemetics. Aprepitant may increase ifosfamide brain toxicity, so pharmacy must review the combination. Growth factor is included from day 6. Retain prescribed mouth care, pain relief and stomach protection.
